newsitem.title: USA: Regent Bancshares places stock privately.
newsitem.headline: Regent Bancshares places stock privately.

text.p: Regent Bancshares Corp said it completed a $9.5 million private placement of the common stock of its subsidiary, Regent National Bank, to selected institutions and other investors at $8.50 per share.
Regent National's stock is exchangeable into the common stock of Regent Bancshares under prescribed future conditions.
The investment banking firm of Keefe, Bruyette & Woods Inc acted as Regent National's exclusive financial adviser and placement agent.
Regent Bancshares is a one-bank holding company, which owns and operates Regent National Bank, a commercial bank in Philadelphia.
